bullets.title: META Compute Cloud: Bull/Bear Debate Rages as Semis Sell Off Hard
bullets.body: META's plan to monetize excess AI compute capacity triggered a violent sector rotation — SOX -9%, neoclouds down ~10% on fears of overbuild. Bears (Ed Zitron, PSC Macro) argue it signals hyperscaler overcapacity vs. AI end-demand; bulls (Jefferies, Citi, Klein) counter META's capex is unchanged (~$200B planned '25-26), cloud play boosts ROIC/FCF, and AI demand still runs ~4x available supply. Jefferies maintains BUY on META with $825 PT (46% upside); Citi holds Buy at $850 PT noting compute offering shores up FCF while Prometheus/Hyperion builds continue. META click-to-message estimated at $40B ad revenue in 2026 (16% of total), growing faster than overall ads — an underappreciated earnings driver.

bullets.title: NVDA/AMD/CRWV/NBIS: Collateral Damage from META Cloud Pivot
bullets.body: DA Davidson flags that if META scales back compute ambitions it would reduce orders to AVGO and AMD before NVDA, preserving NVDA's strategic position. CRWV (META ~33% of backlog) and NBIS (META >50% of backlog) fell 14% and 17% respectively; DA Davidson notes CRWV's strategic value intact as META committed to ~$35B capex and cannot resell CRWV capacity. JPM revises AI server TAMs higher: Servers +9/+12/+20% for '26/'27/'28; CRDO holds ~82% chip share in AEC with +28% CAGR. DELL gaining server share (21% in 1Q26 vs 10% YoY); ANET leads DC Ethernet at 22% share.

bullets.title: PLTR: DA Davidson Upgrades to Buy, PT $175; FCF Margins Doubling
bullets.body: DA Davidson upgrades PLTR to Buy from Neutral (PT $175 from $165), citing compelling valuation reset (200x to 50x NTM PE) while growing 2x faster than peers. FCF margins doubled last year, expected to double again this year then grow 50% next year. PLTR's unique moat in combining disparate data sources via Forward Deployed Engineers reaching C-suite cited as durable differentiator; PLTR-NVDA open-source model deal addresses Frontier Labs concerns. Stock +3.6% pre-market.

bullets.title: ADBE: HSBC Upgrades to Buy, Raises PT to $308
bullets.body: HSBC analyst Stephen Bersey upgrades ADBE to Buy and raises price target to $308 from $282. Stock +1.7% pre-market. Infrastructure-exposed software (including ADBE peers MSFT, ORCL, NET) returning +18.5% YTD vs application software down 26.5% per KeyBanc, though ADBE categorized more with large-cap apps which are down 33.5% equal-weighted YTD.

bullets.title: TSLA: Q2 Deliveries Beat at 480k (+25% YoY), Energy Storage Slight Miss
bullets.body: Tesla Q2 deliveries came in at 480k vs. 397k consensus (+25% YoY), a significant beat. Energy storage at 13.5 GWh (+34% YoY) was a slight miss vs. 13.9 GWh consensus. NHTSA separately closed its 2022 probe of 695k Tesla vehicles over unexpected deceleration, citing low hazard.

bullets.title: HOOD: Klein Sees $130 PT as Global Brokerage Hyperscaler with $600B+ TAM
bullets.body: Klein Macro outlines a bullish HOOD thesis: fragmented online brokerage market with no global leader, HOOD positioned as technology-native platform targeting 10x revenue growth. Recent catalysts include Bitstamp acquisition (June 2025), WonderFi (June 2026), 24/7 tokenized stocks, stablecoin lending, and blockchain launch. Expanding to Canada, UK crypto, eyeing Singapore. PT $130 at ~18x FY27E revenue vs. current 14x. Stock +3.9% pre-market on crypto-related rally.

bullets.title: MU: DA Davidson Notes 8x Earnings Valuation Despite Positive Fundamentals
bullets.body: DA Davidson flags MU trading at only 8x earnings with bear case narratives ramping, but views fundamentals as still positive. UBS separately notes memory revenues expected +50% in 2027 driven by AI demand, with ASML 2027/28 EPS raised 9%/14% (now 22%/33% above consensus). Morgan Stanley warns of 'chipflation' — memory prices rising sharply on AI demand, marking the end of the falling-cost era.

bullets.title: AVGO: CEO & CFO Non-Deal Roadshow July 7 via Wolfe Research
bullets.body: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan and CFO Amie Thuener conducting virtual non-deal roadshow on July 7 hosted by Wolfe Research. DA Davidson notes AVGO would face reduced orders before NVDA if META scales back compute ambitions. No rating change.

bullets.title: META/GOOGL/AD ECOSYSTEM: AMZN DSP and APP Winning Ad Checks; TTD, SNAP, PINS Lagging
bullets.body: UBS ad channel checks show 2Q budgets finishing better than expected, with performance advertising gaining over brand platforms. AMZN DSP and AppLovin standout winners; TTD, SNAP, and PINS remain under pressure from brand-spend weakness. Roth Capital separately notes tier-2 platforms (AppLovin, Reddit, Pinterest) gaining advertiser traction, with debate over whether ChatGPT could attract budget shifts.

bullets.title: AAPL: 5 New iPhones Planned for CY26, Including ~10M Foldable Units; Chip Talks with CXMT/YMTC
bullets.body: AAPL CY26 iPhone production expected 'well above' 220M units with 5 new models; ~10M foldable units planned. AAPL in talks to buy chips from Chinese memory makers CXMT and YMTC while seeking White House support. 2027 roadmap includes M7 chip, new iPad Pro, iPhone Air 2, and smart glasses but faces severe memory/chip shortages. Stock +0.2% pre-market.

bullets.title: GOOGL: €4.7B EU Antitrust Fine Upheld by Bloc's Highest Court
bullets.body: Google's €4.13B ($4.70B) EU antitrust fine for anti-competitive Android practices upheld by the EU's top court. Google also separately ordered to pay Klarna $1.5B in antitrust damages. No rating changes noted.

bullets.title: SMCI: Taiwan Authorities Raid Offices in Chip-Smuggling Probe
bullets.body: Super Micro Computer was raided as Taiwan expanded its chip-smuggling investigation. No broker rating actions noted alongside the headline.

bullets.title: ENPH: Pivoting to AI Infrastructure as Power Semiconductor Platform
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley notes Enphase rebranding as a power semiconductor platform expanding into AI infrastructure, solid-state transformers, and benefiting from the 800V architecture transition. Positioned as a beneficiary of data center power demand growth alongside fuel cell developers.

bullets.title: DKNG: Citi Cuts 2Q Adj EBITDA to $222M (from $265M) but Stays Buy at $30 PT
bullets.body: Citi lowers DraftKings 2Q adj EBITDA estimate to $222M from $265M due to DraftKings Predictions marketing spend pulled forward into 2Q vs. expected 2H. FY adj EBITDA estimate of $787M remains ahead of Street's $767M. PT unchanged at $30, Buy-rated.

bullets.title: NOW/ACN Cybersecurity Partnership; Software Sector Rotation Update
bullets.body: Accenture enhancing cybersecurity capabilities via ServiceNow partnership with new AI-powered services for migrating off legacy platforms. KeyBanc notes infrastructure software (MSFT, ORCL, NET) +18.5% YTD vs. application software -26.5%; large-cap software down 33.5% equal-weighted. Software/SaaS rebounded on CRM/NOW-related activity per Citi.

bullets.title: CRWV: Hits 52-Week Low, Down ~11-14% on META Compute News
bullets.body: CRWV hit a 52-week low (C$16.64, -11.7% intraday on Canadian listing) following META's AI compute monetization announcement. DA Davidson and Jefferies argue CRWV's strategic value is intact — META committed to ~$35B capex and cannot resell CRWV capacity — but with META >33% of CRWV's backlog the overhang is material near-term.

bullets.title: SHOP: +4.8% in Canadian Trading; GS Communacopia Conference Participation Confirmed
bullets.body: Shopify +4.8% (C$170.12) in mid-morning Canadian trading. SHOP also confirmed as participant at Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference (Sept 8-11, San Francisco), one of 100+ tech companies holding 1x1 meetings. No fundamental catalyst cited for today's move.

bullets.title: TSMC: JPMorgan Scheduling Earnings Preview Call for July 7
bullets.body: JPMorgan analyst Gokul Hariharan hosting a TSMC earnings preview call on Tuesday, July 7. Klein Macro notes semis chop expected until mid-July earnings (TSM, ASML, MU) with SOX trading a $13k-$14.6k range since mid-June.

bullets.title: GEV: Jefferies BUY with $1,210 PT; CEO/CFO NYC Roadshow July 29
bullets.body: Jefferies analyst Julien Dumoulin-Smith rates GE Vernova Buy with a $1,210 PT. CEO and IR conducting investor meetings in New York on July 29 hosted by Jefferies. Data center power demand remains a structural tailwind — data center starts up 113% and power projects up 117% over trailing six months per UBS.

bullets.title: GS Communacopia + Technology Conference: Key Universe Names Confirmed for Sept 8-11
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference (Sept 8-11, Palace Hotel, San Francisco) includes 100+ tech companies for 1x1 meetings. New additions: CrowdStrike (CRWD), Intel (INTC), Twilio (TWLO). Universe names confirmed include NVDA, MSFT, META, ORCL, PLTR, AMZN, GOOGL, NFLX, TSLA, AVGO, AMD, ANET, NET, NOW, SNOW, SHOP, UBER, RDDT, PINS, APP, DELL, and others. Investor meeting requests due July 21.
